title: Roasted Sweet Potatoes
description: Sweet potato cubes roasted with olive oil, smoked paprika and garlic until caramelized outside and creamy inside.

image.alt: Roasted sweet potato chunks on a sheet pan

ingredients.prep: cut into {len 1 in} cubes, peeled or not

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, salt, paprika and garlic powder on the baking sheet.
Spread them out in a single layer with space between. Roast, turning once halfway, until tender and caramelized at the edges, {time 25-30 min}.

notes: Leftovers are good in grain bowls, tacos and salads.
